#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int compute(int n, int m) {
    if (n <= 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    int previous_result = 17;
    int current_result = 17;
    int size_limit = (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 2 + 1;
    int toggle = 1;
    vector<vector<int>> table(2, vector<int>(size_limit + 1, 0));
    table[0][0] = 1;
    table[0][1] = 2;
    table[0][2] = 2;
    table[0][3] = 1;
    for (int m_value = 4; m_value < n; ++m_value) {
        int total_pairs = m_value * (m_value - 1) / 2;
        current_result = (m_value + 1) * previous_result;
        int partial_sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m_value; ++i) {
            partial_sum += table[toggle ^ 1][i];
            table[toggle][i] = partial_sum % m;
        }
        for (int i = m_value; i <= total_pairs / 2; ++i) {
            partial_sum += table[toggle ^ 1][i];
            partial_sum -= table[toggle ^ 1][i - m_value];
            table[toggle][i] = partial_sum % m;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= total_pairs / 2; ++i) {
            table[toggle][total_pairs - i] = table[toggle][i];
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < total_pairs; ++i) {
            int temp_sum = 0;
            int start_j = max(1, -total_pairs + i + m_value + 2);
            for (int j = start_j; j <= m_value; ++j) {
                int index = m_value + 2 - j + i;
                if (index >= 0 && index <= total_pairs) {
                    temp_sum += j * table[toggle][index];
                }
            }
            total += table[toggle][i];
            total %= m;
            temp_sum %= m;
            current_result += temp_sum * total;
            current_result %= m;
        }
        previous_result = current_result;
        toggle ^= 1;
    }
    return current_result % m;
}

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << compute(n, m) << endl;
    return 0;
}
